name: calls/decode
doc: the decode call's contract: every (d_v, levels, decay) FSLA accepts. A list is alternatives, each its own context; a range is one context. d_v is a range because the seam pads any value width up to the arm that serves it (decode's launch function maps d_v into the arm's, common/plan/decode_launch.h).

d_v.declared_by: docs/internals/decode/arms_gen.md#the-contract: the value widths a decode arm serves, 2 up to its widest arm; fsla/_state.py's StateFormat admits an even width from 2

levels.declared_by: docs/internals/decode/decode.md#kmaxlevels-2: kMaxLevels, the hierarchy depths the step's per-level arrays hold

decay.declared_by: docs/internals/decode/arms_gen.md#the-contract: the recurrence either decays (1) or not (0)
